canonical_project: Burkina Faso Government twin modular data centers (Cloud Gouvernemental)
owner: Government of Burkina Faso / Ministry of Digital Transition, Posts and Electronic Communications
notes: Two modular data centers in Ouagadougou inaugurated 2026-01-23 by PM Rimtalba Jean Emmanuel Ouédraogo, both located in Ouagadougou (two sites under 100 km apart). Combined capacity: ~3 PB storage, 28,800 CPU cores, 105.6 TB RAM, 7,000+ VMs (100-300 VMs per ministry); cost ~15.2-16 bn FCFA (~USD 29m); managed by national staff; 5-10 days energy autonomy. Part of the government's 'zero external data' / data-sovereignty program; 10x previous public-sector hosting capacity. MW capacity not disclosed.
